# 4 Ezra Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Ezra restores the scriptures

---

**14:1** And-it-came-to-pass upon-the-third-day, sitting-under-an-oak, behold! a-voice-came-out-of-a-bush-over-against-me and-said: Ezra, Ezra!

**14:2** And-I-said: Here-am-I, LORD; and-I-rose-to-my-feet.

**14:3** Then-said-he-to-me: In-the-bush-I-manifested-myself-to-Moses, and-spoke-to-him when-my-people-were-in-bondage-in-Egypt;

**14:4** and-I-sent-him-and-led-my-people-out-of-Egypt, and-I-brought-him-up-to-mount-Sinai, where-I-held-him-with-me-many-days.

**14:5** And-I-told-him-many-wondrous-things, and-showed-him-the-secrets-of-the-times, and-the-end-of-the-seasons; and-I-commanded-him, saying:

**14:6** These-words-you-shall-publish-openly, and-these-you-shall-hide.

**14:7** And-now-I-say-the-same-to-you:

**14:8** Lay-up-in-your-heart the-signs-that-I-have-shown-you, the-dreams-that-you-have-seen, and-the-interpretations-which-you-have-heard;

**14:9** for-you-shall-be-taken-up-from-among-men, and-from-henceforth-you-shall-remain-with-my-son and-with-those-who-are-like-you, until-the-times-are-ended.

**14:10** For-the-world-has-lost-its-youth, and-the-times-begin-to-wax-old.

**14:11** For-the-age-is-divided-into-twelve-parts, and-nine-of-its-parts-have-already-passed,

**14:12** and-half-of-the-tenth-part; and-there-remain-two-of-its-parts-after-the-middle-of-the-tenth-part.

**14:13** Therefore-set-your-house-in-order, and-reprove-your-people, and-comfort-the-lowly-among-them, and-let-go-already-of-corruptible-things,

**14:14** and-renounce-mortal-considerations, and-cast-away-from-you-the-burdens-of-man, and-divest-yourself-now-of-your-weak-nature,

**14:15** and-lay-aside-your-inmost-thoughts, and-haste-you-to-escape-from-these-times.

**14:16** For-worse-evils-than-those-which-you-have-seen-shall-be-done-hereafter.

**14:17** For-look-at-the-weakness-of-those-who-are-to-age: as-they-become-older-they-become-ever-more-removed-from-the-truth.

**14:18** For-you-think-that-you-shall-grow-in-wisdom-as-you-grow-old; but-the-more-you-age, the-more-shall-you-fail-in-knowledge-and-understanding.

**14:19** For-the-world-has-entered-on-its-decline.

**14:20** Then-I-answered-and-said: Let-me-speak-before-you, O-LORD.

**14:21** For-behold, I-will-go-as-you-have-commanded-me, and-I-will-reprove-those-of-the-present-time; but-who-shall-counsel-those-who-shall-be-born-hereafter?

**14:22** For-the-world-is-set-in-darkness, and-they-who-dwell-in-it-are-without-light.

**14:23** For-your-law-was-burned, and-so-no-one-knows-the-things-that-have-been-done-by-you, or-the-works-that-shall-be-done.

**14:24** If-therefore-I-have-found-grace-before-you, send-into-me-the-Holy-Spirit, and-I-will-write-everything-that-has-happened-in-the-world-since-the-beginning — the-things-that-were-written-in-your-law — that-men-may-be-able-to-find-the-path and-that-those-who-wish-to-live-in-the-last-days-may-live.

**14:25** And-he-answered-me-and-said: Go-and-gather-the-people, and-say-to-them-that-they-seek-you-not-for-forty-days.

**14:26** But-prepare-for-yourself-many-tablets-of-boxwood, and-take-with-you-Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ethan, and-Asiel — these-five who-are-ready-to-write-swiftly.

**14:27** And-come-here, and-I-will-light-in-your-heart the-lamp-of-understanding, which-shall-not-be-put-out-till-the-things-are-ended-which-you-shall-write.

**14:28** And-when-you-have-done-this, some-things-you-shall-publish-openly, and-some-you-shall-deliver-secretly-to-the-wise; tomorrow-at-this-hour-you-shall-begin-to-write.

**14:29** Then-I-went-as-he-commanded-me, and-I-gathered-all-the-people-together, and-said:

**14:30** Hear-these-words, O-Israel.

**14:31** Our-fathers-were-strangers-in-Egypt-in-the-beginning, and-they-were-liberated-from-thence,

**14:32** and-received-the-law-of-life which-they-kept-not, which-you-also-after-them-have-transgressed.

**14:33** Then-the-land-was-given-to-you-for-an-inheritance-in-the-land-of-Zion; but-you-and-your-fathers-committed-iniquity, and-kept-not-the-ways-which-the-Most-High-commanded-you.

**14:34** And-forasmuch-as-he-is-a-righteous-judge, he-took-from-you-in-time-what-he-had-given-you.

**14:35** And-now-you-are-here, and-your-brethren-are-farther-from-you.

**14:36** If-therefore-you-will-rule-over-your-own-understanding, and-instruct-your-hearts, you-shall-be-kept-alive, and-after-death-you-shall-obtain-mercy.

**14:37** For-after-death-shall-come-the-judgment, when-we-shall-live-again: and-then-shall-the-names-of-the-righteous-be-manifest, and-the-deeds-of-the-ungodly-shall-be-declared.

**14:38** Let-no-one-therefore-come-to-me-now, nor-seek-me-for-forty-days.

**14:39** So-I-took-the-five-men-as-he-commanded-me, and-we-went-into-the-field, and-remained-there.

**14:40** And-it-came-to-pass the-next-day that-behold! a-voice-called-me, saying: Ezra, open-your-mouth and-drink-what-I-give-you-to-drink.

**14:41** Then-I-opened-my-mouth, and-behold! there-was-reached-to-me a-full-cup, which-was-full-as-it-were-of-water, but-the-color-thereof-was-like-fire.

**14:42** And-I-took-it-and-drank; and-when-I-had-drunk-of-it, my-heart-poured-forth-understanding, and-wisdom-grew-in-my-chest, for-my-spirit-retained-its-memory.

**14:43** And-my-mouth-was-opened-and-was-no-more-shut.

**14:44** The-Most-High-also-gave-understanding-to-the-five-men, and-they-wrote-in-turn-what-was-dictated, in-characters-which-they-knew-not.

**14:45** And-they-sat-forty-days, and-they-wrote-in-the-day-time, and-at-night-they-ate-bread.

**14:46** But-as-for-me, I-spoke-in-the-day-time, and-by-night-I-held-not-my-tongue.

**14:47** So-in-the-forty-days-there-were-written-ninety-four-books.

**14:48** And-it-came-to-pass when-the-forty-days-were-fulfilled, that-the-Most-High-spoke, saying: The-first-that-you-have-written-publish-openly, that-the-worthy-and-unworthy-may-read-it;

**14:49** but-keep-the-seventy-last, that-you-may-deliver-them-only-to-such-as-be-wise-among-your-people:

**14:50** for-in-them-is-the-spring-of-understanding, the-fountain-of-wisdom, and-the-stream-of-knowledge.
